os_version: macOS 26.5.2 (25F84), Apple Silicon, live user session
app: Finder (system file manager), probe folder with 3 throwaway files

stack_detection.method: system process, always running; AX answers immediately
stack_detection.signature: com.apple.finder; full window tree on first query (no AT-latch)

channel_setup: Accessibility TCC only. Window opened via 'open <dir>' (no Apple Events needed). NOTE: closing the window via AppleScript hit a pending Automation-consent dialog (Terminal→Finder) and timed out (-1712); the coordinate-free fallback worked instantly: AXPress on the window's AXCloseButton — the AX channel needs no per-app consent beyond the one global Accessibility grant.

t1_read_text.detail: All 3 probe filenames (alpha/bravo/charlie.txt) present as exact strings in the window tree.

t2_enumerate.detail: 178 nodes / 17.4 KB / 85 ms: toolbar, sidebar favorites, file rows with per-file frames and AXSelected state.

t3_live_value.detail: No text field exercised (rename field exists but was left untouched).

t5_blind_action.detail: Blind click at the AXFrame center of 'bravo.txt' (no screenshot used): file selected; verified in-channel — exactly one row reports AXSelected=true and it is bravo.txt.

measurements.notes: Raw serialization is attribute-heavy (17.4 KB); the agent-relevant subset (file rows + frames + selection) is ~2 KB. Selection state readable per-row makes click-verification free — no screenshot round-trip to confirm an action landed.

runtime_verification.method: In-channel verification of the blind click (AXSelected flip on exactly the intended row).
